course_name_original: Design of power electronic converters - selected issues
course_name_en: Design of power electronic converters - selected issues

learning_outcomes.text: Knows the problems related to the operation and design of power electronic systems
Knows supporting tools and basic rules used in the design of converter systems
Knows the properties and applications of power semiconductor components
Using specialized software, can design a simple printed circuit board (PCB)
Using specialized software, can model and perform simulation tests of a power electronic converter
Possesses the basic knowledge necessary for designing power electronic systems

syllabus_topics: Discussion of issues related to the design of electronic and power electronic systems
Modeling of power electronic and electronic systems using professional software - laboratory exercises
Discussion of design support software, i.e., LTSPICE simulation package, Matlab Simulink, PCB design software, and finite element method modeling software.
Introduction to PCB design using the Altium Designer package
Introduction to finite element method modeling
Selection of tools necessary for testing and commissioning power electronic systems. Measurements in power electronic systems
Issues related to cooling power components in converter systems
Principles of designing printed circuit boards for power electronics applications
Selection of components and design of power circuits in converter systems
assessment_rules: Completing the classes is based on presenting a solution to the posed problem (in the form of a project) and on the results of tests. Passing the module is possible after passing all laboratory classes with a positive grade. Students are required to prepare for the exercise being performed, which may be verified by an oral or written colloquium.
